rows.en: Time to finish you off!!! Now die!!!
...I know not. But this... So this is what it means to "protect"...
With those words, Zamsha slowly crumpled to the ground where he stood.
I-I've done it... The grief and the pain the heroes suffered from Zamsha's death...
These powerful negative emotions... have completed the "Memory Memory"...
...With this, the better ending will be complete.
Tough luck. I've helped myself to the Memory.
Belial...!! I can't forgive... you, of all people!!
Belial...!! Like hell I'll forgive you!!
Belial...!! You... I'll never forgive you!!
Belial...!! You're the one guy I ain't ever forgivin'!!
Belial...!! I will not forgive evil like you!!
Belial... You are a distortion... and I will sever it!!
Belial... You, of all people, I cannot forgive!!
Belial!! You're the one I'll never forgive!!
Belial!! ...I won't forgive you!! You're someone who shouldn't even be alive!!
Hmph!! You lot may have beaten Dinosaur Greeed, but defeating me is impossible!!
Are you so sure about that!?
Taking down Dinosaur Greeed stopped the erosion of Veda!!
Huh!? So the brat who wormed his way into Veda is back on his feet?
Not completely yet, but I'm taking it back.
And now, Belial!! You won't be able to use the Colony Laser!!
I don't need to rely on something like that. I'm the strongest. You lot can never win!!
Heh heh heh, hahahaha!!! Now do you see how powerless you are?

notes.note: Speakers verified against 0731.bla (MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N shows entry N+1); all extractor labels match, no shift. Belial delivers the killing blow meant for the leader; Zamsha takes it (#0.468, continues story_165 #0.465-466).

#0.469-483 = 15 identical leader-variant rows (the 'Nu Gundam' label is the script's placeholder leader name). 'Naze, omae ga' = why did Zamsha, of all beings, shield them; rendered 'Why would you...!?', one line for all.
Zamsha keeps archaic speech ('I know not'). The quoted word 'protect' kept in quotes like the source; ties back to his Mebius-era theme of learning what protecting means.
Narration (no CharaNameIn; this entry is not visible in the dumped script calls, but the content is plain narration).
#0.486-500 = leader-variant block, all identical; one line.
Dinosaur Greeed (Dr. Maki), dying after the battle. 'Yarimashita yo' has no stated subject; rendered 'I-I've done it' since the completed Memory is his project. Could also read 'It worked'.
'Yoki shuumatsu' = 'better ending', matching story_165 #0.387 ('For the sake of a better ending!!').
'Ore-sama ga itadaita' = Belial has taken the Memory for himself: 'I've helped myself to the Memory'.

#0.509-523 = leader-variant block (TextIdOffset+508+k). The Pt_Chara_Check chain used in story_165 (OOO, W, Momotaros, RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, 00, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Nu) fits slots 10-14 (#0.519 Setsuna's 'distortion', #0.522 Kamille's 'shouldn't be alive', #0.521 Domon's rough line) but NOT slots 0-9: the wording reads Mebius, Zero, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Momotaros ('omee'), RX ('evil like you'), Rider 1. Voiced each slot from its own wording, per the brief, so the English fits either order. Identical 'yurusen' rows (#0.511-513, #0.518) share one line.
Kamille's line echoing his words to Scirocco: 'You're someone who shouldn't even be alive!!'.
Seravee's Voice (Tieria): 'Sore wa, dou ka na' as a challenge to Belial's boast.
'Erosion of Veda' reused from story_157 #0.74 / story_160. Ankh realising the cause: subject restored as 'Taking down Dinosaur Greeed'.
Belial calls Seravee a 'gaki' (brat) who got into Veda; Seravee is male per glossary, so 'his'.
'Dakkan shitsutsu aru' = in the middle of retaking Veda; subject 'I' (Seravee) restored.

#0.535-549 = leader-variant pain cries as Belial's beam hits (same block layout). Each cry follows the established corpus spellings (Gwaah, Uwaah, Whoa, Ngh, Gwah, Gaaah, Ugh); identical Japanese gets identical English.
Laugh style follows story_165 #0.464 ('Heh heh heh, hahahaha'). The sentence continues into story_167 #0.552.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0731.bla; extractor labels correct (no shift). Leader block #0.509-523: wording does not match the story_165 Pt_Chara_Check order in slots 0-9 (reads Ultras first, then Riders); voiced from wording. #0.502 subject of 'yarimashita' inferred as Maki ('I've done it'). #0.485 narration not visible in the script dump. 'Erosion of Veda' reused. No new names or terms.
